consequence.statement: Service connections using Direct-Server-Return that were established prior to Cilium v1.13.3 will be disrupted and need to be re-established.

original.statement: Service connections using Direct-Server-Return that were established before Cilium v1.13.3 will be disrupted on upgrade and must be re-established.

decision.reason: [ev-89034c5d2c74] says directly that Direct-Server-Return service connections established before Cilium v1.13.3 "will be disrupted, and need to be re-established". That means running connections break, so workload-failure (mandatory work) fits. It isn't behavior-change, because the connections don't keep working differently. It isn't migration-required either, because no operator step has to run before or after the upgrade to prevent this. The proposed statement matches the evidence wording, and medium severity is a reasonable reading of a disruption that can be fixed by reconnecting.
